hero.title: Plan Governance & Committee Support
hero.subtitle: Build a stronger fiduciary process with documented governance and ongoing governance support.

blocks.text: Good fiduciary governance isn't about checking boxes—it's about creating a documented process that helps your retirement plan committee make informed decisions, fulfill its ERISA responsibilities, and act in the best interests of plan participants.

PointOak Retirement Advisors supports ERISA fiduciary governance through committee support, fiduciary documentation, investment oversight, and ongoing guidance. We help organizations establish and maintain a governance framework that supports prudent decision-making and an organized record of the process over time.

sections.title: Benefits of Plan Governance & Committee Support

body.text: ERISA focuses on following a prudent process—not achieving perfect investment performance. Documenting committee discussions, benchmarking decisions, and investment reviews helps demonstrate that your fiduciaries are acting responsibly.
Well-defined governance establishes who makes decisions, how those decisions are documented, and when reviews occur, helping committees operate more effectively.

Meeting minutes, investment reviews, benchmarking reports, committee actions, and fiduciary files create a permanent record of your governance process and strengthen your organization's compliance posture.
Regular governance reviews can identify changes in plan responsibilities, procedures, provider roles, or legal requirements that warrant attention from the appropriate professionals.
With experienced fiduciary guidance supporting your committee, decision-making becomes more consistent, organized, and easier to defend if questions ever arise.

sections.title: How Plan Governance & Committee Support Works

blocks.text: Effective retirement plan governance combines several ongoing responsibilities into one documented process. Investment monitoring, provider reviews, committee meetings, fiduciary documentation, and compliance oversight all work together to demonstrate prudent fiduciary management.

PointOak helps retirement plan sponsors establish governance procedures, maintain fiduciary records, support committee meetings, review service providers, and document investment decisions throughout the year.
Rather than preparing documentation only when it's needed, we help create a repeatable governance process that becomes part of your committee's normal operations.

sections.title: Who Benefits from Plan Governance & Committee Support?

blocks.text: Organizations often seek governance support when retirement plan responsibilities become more complex or internal resources are limited.

items.title: Your Committee Needs a More Structured Process

body.text: Committee meetings happen regularly, but documentation, responsibilities, and follow-up actions are inconsistent. A formal governance framework creates greater accountability and continuity.
If committee minutes, benchmarking reports, or investment reviews are difficult to locate—or don't exist—a governance review can help establish better documentation practices.

items.title: Your Plan Hasn't Been Reviewed Recently

body.text: Governance reviews consider whether committee procedures, investment oversight, and provider responsibilities remain appropriate as the plan changes.
As plans increase in size and complexity, fiduciary responsibilities grow as well. Strong governance provides structure that supports long-term plan management.

items.title: You're Preparing for an Audit or Regulatory Review

body.text: Whether responding to a Department of Labor inquiry or conducting an internal governance review, organized documentation and clearly defined fiduciary processes make preparation significantly easier.

When governance consulting may not be necessary: Organizations with newly established retirement plans or very small plans may only need periodic compliance reviews until their committee structure and fiduciary responsibilities become more complex.

blocks.text: Governance and compliance work together, but they serve different purposes.
Strong governance supports compliance, while good compliance reinforces a prudent governance process. Together, they create the foundation for effective retirement plan oversight.

body.text: We review your committee structure, fiduciary responsibilities, governance documents, investment oversight process, and current compliance practices.
You'll receive recommendations for improving committee procedures, fiduciary documentation, governance policies, and ongoing oversight.
We continue supporting your committee through governance guidance, investment reviews, benchmarking, documentation, and fiduciary consulting throughout the year.

a.text: ERISA governance is the framework retirement plan committees use to oversee their plan, including documenting decisions, monitoring investments, reviewing providers, and fulfilling fiduciary responsibilities.

items.q: What's the difference between governance and compliance?

a.text: Compliance focuses on meeting ERISA requirements and regulatory obligations. Governance establishes the decision-making process that helps committees consistently meet those responsibilities.

items.q: How often should a retirement plan committee meet?

a.text: Most retirement plan committees meet quarterly to review investments, provider performance, benchmarking, participant outcomes, and fiduciary matters. Additional meetings may be appropriate during major plan changes.

items.q: What documentation should retirement plan committees maintain?

a.text: Committees should maintain meeting minutes, investment review reports, benchmarking analyses, provider evaluations, fiduciary decisions, Investment Policy Statements, and governance documents that support their fiduciary process.

ERISA emphasizes a prudent process. Well-organized documentation demonstrates that fiduciaries considered relevant information, evaluated alternatives, and acted in the best interests of plan participants.

items.q: How can PointOak help improve our governance process?

a.text: PointOak helps establish committee procedures, strengthen fiduciary documentation, support investment oversight, benchmark providers, review governance practices, and provide ongoing guidance that supports long-term compliance.
